d:
From the eerie Bracken Fern Manor and Tudor House to the mysterious Haunted Museum, every location has its own dark history and unanswered questions. The Ghost Adventures crew steps into abandoned buildings, historic landmarks and places with chilling reputations, determined to uncover what lies behind each haunting. But how does each investigation finally come to an end?
Watch Ghost Adventures, S12, Episodes 3, 4, 6, 9, 10, 11 & 13 on Discovery Channel India
